_provenance.source: Built and geometrically validated in a separate Claude chat session (Rhino source -> scale-corrected -> harmonic lens/rim/bridge coupling -> self-intersection tested). See Gold_Template/README.md and reports/ in that package for full derivation and validation numbers. This descriptor adapts that geometry to this repo's existing backend/deformer schema (different from that package's own basis.npz/constraints.json schema - the two are not the same format, this file is the bridge between them.
_provenance.not_yet_validated_against: This repo's actual backend/deformer/*.py deformers (bridge_deformer.py, temple_deformer.py, rim_deformer.py) were read for schema requirements only, not executed end-to-end against this descriptor - see integration notes.
_provenance.axis_convention_note: This template's coordinate convention (from its own build spec) is X=left/right, Y=front/back(depth), Z=up/down. This repo's descriptor_loader._load_lens_planes defaults width/height to geom.extents[0]/[1], which assumes a different axis order and silently produced height_mm=2.9 (actually the lens depth) instead of the real ~36.9mm on first load - caught by actually running the loader, not assumed. Fixed here via the aspect_width_mm/aspect_height_mm override fields the loader already supports. NOT fixed: any other axis-order assumptions inside bridge_deformer.py, rim_deformer.py, temple_deformer.py were not checked - only descriptor_loader.py was exercised end-to-end. Verify axis handling there before trusting deformation output.
_provenance.vertex_groups_note: UPDATED: Bridge/LeftRim/RightRim are now real, separately-named GLB mesh nodes (extracted as genuine sub-meshes of Frame using the exact vertex-index region masks already computed and validated during this template's build - see Gold_Template/metadata/masks.json region_masks). This was necessary because mesh_aliases only resolves inside DescriptorLoader's internal geometry dict and does NOT propagate to DeformationContext.meshes (confirmed by actually running MeshDeformer.deform() end-to-end and hitting a real KeyError before this fix). mesh_aliases is left empty now since it's no longer needed for this template.
